mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW')) as todo, count(*) filter (where status = 'WRITE_OFF_PENDING') as pending, count(*) filter (where status in ('RESOLVED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')) as done, count(*) as "all", count(*) filter (where status = 'OPEN' and sla_due_at < #{now}) as overdue from recon_exceptions

select source_code as source, coalesce(sum(abs(diff_amount)), 0) as amount, count(*) as count from recon_exceptions where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'WRITE_OFF_PENDING') group by source_code order by 2 desc

select p.id as line_id, p.txn_at, p.fee, p.amount + p.fee as gross, o.cod_amount as cod, o.amount as order_amount, x.extra, x.exception_id from payment_lines p join match_items mi on mi.group_id = p.match_group_id and mi.order_code is not null join oms.orders o on o.code = mi.order_code left join lateral ( select e.id as exception_id, (e.meta->>'actualFee')::bigint - (e.meta->>'expectedFee')::bigint as extra from exception_payments ep join recon_exceptions e on e.id = ep.exception_id where ep.payment_line_id = p.id and e.type = 'FEE_DIFF' order by e.created_at limit 1 ) x on true where p.source_code = #{source} and p.fee_checked and p.txn_at >= #{since} and (select count(*) from match_items m2 where m2.group_id = p.match_group_id and m2.order_code is not null) = 1

select g.id, g.method, g.confidence, (select string_agg(mi.order_code, ',' order by mi.order_code) from match_items mi where mi.group_id = g.id and mi.order_code is not null) as order_codes, p.external_ref as payment_ref, p.amount, p.fee from payment_lines p join import_files f on f.id = p.file_id join match_groups g on g.id = p.match_group_id where f.business_date = #{date} and p.source_code = #{source} order by g.method <> 'EXACT', g.id limit 300

with owed as ( select o.pay_via as source, (#{asOf}::date - (o.delivered_at at time zone #{zone})::date) as age, case when o.cod_amount > 0 then o.cod_amount else o.amount end as amount from oms.orders o where o.status = 'DELIVERED' and o.pay_via in ('GHN', 'GHTK', 'SHOPEE', 'TIKTOK') and not exists (select 1 from match_items mi where mi.order_code = o.code) and not exists (select 1 from exception_orders eo join recon_exceptions e on e.id = eo.exception_id where eo.order_code = o.code and e.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF') ) select source, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where age <= 7), 0) as b0, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where age between 8 and 30), 0) as b1, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where age between 31 and 60), 0) as b2, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where age > 60), 0) as b3 from owed group by source order by sum(amount) desc

with matched as ( select f.business_date as d, p.source_code as s, sum(p.amount) as amt, sum(p.fee) as fee from payment_lines p join import_files f on f.id = p.file_id where p.status = 'MATCHED' and f.business_date >= #{from} and f.business_date < #{to} group by 1, 2 ) select date, source, kind, amount, ref from ( select d as date, s as source, 'IN' as kind, amt as amount, null as ref from matched union all select d, s, 'FEE', fee, null from matched where fee > 0 union all select (e.resolved_at at time zone #{zone})::date, e.source_code, case when e.diff_amount < 0 then 'WRITE_OFF_LOSS' else 'WRITE_OFF_GAIN' end, abs(e.diff_amount), e.id from recon_exceptions e where e.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' and e.resolved_at >= #{fromTs} and e.resolved_at < #{toTs} ) x order by date, kind, source, ref
select source_code as source, received_at, total_rows, status from import_files where received_at >= #{from} and received_at < #{to} and status not in ('DUPLICATE', 'FAILED') order by received_at
